Scene: fruit salad plate with pineapple, strawberries, blueberries, and chocolate-coated or chocolate truffle pieces (three brown round items).

Vessel: square white plate ~26 cm side, area ~676 cm^2 (treated as dinner plate, 26 cm × 26 cm)

pineapple chunks (yellow, many pieces): 22% -> 149 cm^2 x 2 = 298 ml x 0.6 = 179 g x 50 = 89 kcal
strawberries (halves and whole): 14% -> 95 cm^2 x 2 = 190 ml x 0.6 = 114 g x 32 = 36 kcal
blueberries: 3% -> 20 cm^2 x 1.5 = 30 ml x 0.6 = 18 g x 57 = 10 kcal
chocolate pieces (3 round/truffle-like): 5% -> 34 cm^2 x 2.5 = 85 ml x 0.9 = 77 g x 500 = 385 kcal

Check: ~44% covered, 374 g, 520 kcal. Plausible for a fruit side portion with a few chocolate pieces; the chocolate dominates the energy, so the estimate is sensitive to whether those pieces are chocolate (~500 kcal/100g) or a lower-energy item.
